title: Quote node --test globs in npm scripts
body: Wrap each glob in escaped double quotes in package.json so node --test expands it itself. Unquoted, sh on Linux and macOS expands ** without globstar as a single level and silently skips nested test files, while Windows passes the pattern through and runs them all; this memory's check says so at the edit. Why: on 2026-09-22 the same suite ran 323 tests on Windows and 245 on Linux with no error; quoting the globs brought Linux to the full count.
not_derivable: The scripts quote their globs, but not why: Windows runs the nested files either way, so only a Linux test count shows the loss.

check.say: Quote each node --test glob in the npm script (\"tests/**/*.test.js\"): sh expands ** as one level and skips nested tests.
